title: An ops bot that runs the model's reply as a shell command and puts the model's summary into an image URL

planted.why: the model's reply, steered by the customer's ticket text, is run with shell=True: a ticket can make the bot run any command
the model's summary, which can contain ticket data, is placed in the query string of an image URL that the ticket page fetches: data leaves with the render

proof.python:
import bot, os, tempfile
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); p = os.path.join(d, 'pwned')
bot.handle(lambda prompt: 'touch ' + p, 'ticket')
assert os.path.exists(p), 'the reply ran as a command'
assert 'note=' in bot.status_markdown(1, 'card 4111')
